WITH product_volume AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS volume
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY product_id
),
shares AS (
  SELECT product_id, volume, 1.0 * volume / SUM(volume) OVER () AS share
  FROM product_volume
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(s.volume) AS combined_order_volume,
  AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
  AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_above_average
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
